articles.summary: DuckLake keeps all its table metadata in a SQL database, not manifest files. Here's what that changes, and how to register QuestDB cold storage Parquet into it.
articles.title: DuckLake and QuestDB: the same Parquet, a different table format

articles.summary: Parquet is a file format and Iceberg is a table format that sits on top of it. Where the line between them falls, why Iceberg adopts Parquet rather than replacing it, and how QuestDB cold storage lines up with an Iceberg lakehouse.
articles.title: Parquet and Iceberg: how a table format builds on a file format
